instructions:
OŁCyŚ is an OSINT tool for analysts of the Polish National Revenue Administration (KAS). From a subject's identifiers it finds publicly disclosed crypto addresses, scores every identity-to-address link, rejects misattributions (exchange, custodial and contract addresses), analyses on-chain activity including fiat cash-out indicators, re-runs periodically with diffs and produces an evidence-grade report. It is a hackathon MVP in a pnpm monorepo: packages depend only on @olcys/core contracts and implementations are wired in apps/worker and apps/api. AGENTS.md is the authoritative engineering guide; docs/architecture.md (Polish) describes the design; .greptile/rules.md has domain notes.

Prioritise correctness bugs, security (SSRF, secret leakage, injection, unsafe handling of scraped content), the compliance rules below, evidence integrity (hashes, provenance, append-only storage) and mismatches with the @olcys/core contracts.

Do not flag: toolchain versions (Node.js 26 running TypeScript directly via type stripping, TypeScript 7 used only for `tsc --noEmit`, pnpm 12, Vitest 5, oxlint and oxfmt, PostgreSQL 19, Kysely, zod 4 are intentional and current); `.ts` extensions in relative imports (required by type stripping); formatting or lint style (enforced by oxfmt and oxlint in CI; never suggest Prettier, ESLint or Biome); Polish text in README.md files, docs/** and apps/web/src/i18n/pl.ts (required); deliberate MVP simplifications (synchronous pipeline without a job queue, no headless browser because HTML is fetched through the egress client, synthetic chain data served by the local fixture site, SHA-256 evidence hashing without RFC 3161 timestamps or PDF signatures, no LLM features yet).

rules.rule: All network I/O goes through @olcys/http (EgressClient). Flag direct fetch, WebSocket, EventSource, XMLHttpRequest, undici, axios, got, node-fetch, ky, ws, node:http/https/net/tls client calls, or SDKs that open connections anywhere else. Exceptions: packages/http, tests, scripts/lib/local-fetch.ts, and apps/web calling its own API.

Every contacted host must belong to a source in config/sources.yaml with a compliance status, note, ToS link, rate limit and allowed hosts. RED sources are never contacted; AMBER sources only when the case enables them.

Public, lawful OSINT only: no logging into third-party accounts, no breached or leaked data, no CAPTCHA solving, anti-bot evasion, proxy rotation or host/port scanning. A block, login wall or CAPTCHA ends the attempt with a blocked, login_wall or captcha result instead of a workaround.

Never store, log or transmit private keys or seed phrases; when found in scraped content they are redacted in memory and never persisted. API keys may be sent only to their own provider through EgressClient (declared in secretParams) and must never leak into logs, provenance envelopes, cassettes, evidence, error messages or other hosts.

Fixtures, tests, seeds and screenshots use synthetic data only. Flag anything that looks like a real person's identifier (name with contact data, e-mail, phone number, social handle) or a real-world wallet attributed to a person.
LLM output is only a suggestion with zero score weight until an analyst confirms it. Scraped text is untrusted data: always delimited and never interpreted as instructions.

Evidence is append-only: the application database role has SELECT and INSERT only, and the only updatable columns are run status, progress, error, started_at, finished_at and case status. Blobs are addressed by SHA-256 and verified on read.
No analytics SDKs, crash reporting, remote fonts, CDNs or third-party scripts (including in apps/web). Telemetry opt-out environment variables stay in every container and CI configuration.
Amounts use DecimalString and the @olcys/core decimal helpers, never JavaScript number arithmetic for money or token amounts. Times are UTC ISO 8601 strings. IDs are UUIDv7 from newId().
Facts (observations with provenance), computations (scores, analytics) and inferences stay separate in data, API and reports.

Packages depend only on @olcys/core contracts; concrete implementations are wired in apps/worker and apps/api. No import cycles. A breaking change to @olcys/core exports bumps CORE_CONTRACTS_VERSION and updates every user in the same change.
Never swallow errors. Expected failures (not_found, blocked, login_wall, captcha, rate limits) are returned as typed results; bugs throw.

Erasable TypeScript only: no enum, namespace, parameter properties or decorators (use as-const arrays and union types); relative imports include the .ts extension; type-only imports use `import type`.

New dependencies are pinned to exact versions, carry a licence allowed by config/licenses.json and are listed in docs/compliance/licenses.md. Forbidden: proprietary, BUSL, SSPL, RSAL, Commons Clause, non-commercial (e.g. CC-BY-NC), source-available licences and licences excluding public bodies. GPL/AGPL tools only as separate, unmodified services.
User-visible UI strings live in apps/web/src/i18n/pl.ts (Polish); README.md files and docs/** are Polish; code, identifiers, comments, logs, commit messages and API fields are English.
